body:
Carries the release-owned half of #26073; #26073 keeps everything else (PR #26970). Filing gate ④: an in-flight sub-issue of #26073, claimed by the seat that holds the parent, with domain and grade inherited. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (#20163) · `os-justin` · `session_01QSeKYmTYfaPbLQD4BJfomW`.
Business reason: #26073's PR cannot land green without this. Check Documentation Links on PR #26970 head `43cb2c7e83` (job 122537358057) reports exactly 2 errors. Both are file links to the page that ruling A′ (6417934431) renames. lychee scans the whole repo, so landing #26970 first would leave `main` red for every docs PR.
Reader who acts: the `domain:devx` seat, as a dedicated docs-only PR. The release-owned correction channel (`lanes/devx.md`: factual errors go through a dedicated docs-only PR) is why this is not folded into #26970.
Dedupe: n/a, a sub-issue born from PR #26970's red check.

## The two links (`origin/main`)

- `CHANGELOG.md` L1033: `see [north-star §8](content/docs/concepts/north-star.mdx) "No private expression DSL"`
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx` L1482: a link to `/docs/concepts/north-star`

## Wanted

Point both at the published URL `https://objectstack.ai/docs/concepts/north-star`. That URL works before #26970 (the page exists today) and after it (#26970 adds the redirect `/docs/concepts/north-star` → `/docs/concepts/architecture-overview`). lychee runs offline in CI and excludes `https://`, so the PR is green on both sides of the rename and needs no ordering against #26970. ⛔ Change only the link target; the text around it is history and stays.

## Acceptance

`git grep -n 'concepts/north-star' -- CHANGELOG.md content/docs/releases/` shows only the `https://objectstack.ai/docs/…` form, and Check Documentation Links is green on this PR. After this lands and `main` is merged into PR #26970, its link check is green.
